_why: What the old witch SELLS, as data so the owner can retune the shelf with no rebuild and a server owner can replace it with a datapack and /reload (the pure validator is StockSchema.java; see docs/skillbooks_unique.md). A line is a SLOT on the shelf: at every restock its price is rolled inside [price_min, price_max] from the world seed, the restock period and the slot id (so it is the same for every player and the same after a restart: 'market risk' without anyone being cheated), 'stock' copies are put out (a number, or [min, max]), and 'weight' is the percent chance the slot is on the shelf at all. A bad line is skipped with a sentence shown by /multiverse tree shop status; it never breaks the others. The numbers are the owner's: route books 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 gold, one copy each; SP primers 3 to 5 copies. Keys that start with an underscore are comments. 1.96.0: the SP Book lines are gone with the Skill Points; every book teaches a unique skill.

entries._why: The target of the whole shop (the owner's text: 'The target: the Fang of Smoldering Insanity'; it is the book of its own Exiled Heavy Knight skill). A line of its own so that it can be the flagship: band_low 0.6667 puts its roll in the top third of the band (2,666,700 to 3,000,000 gold), so the book everybody wants is also the dearest, and the all-routes line below skips this route, so it is never on the shelf twice.

Every OTHER Skill Book: one slot per book in the registry, at the owner's band of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 gold, one copy each. 'routes: all' is read when the shelf is rolled, so a book added later by a datapack appears on the shelf with no edit here.
